name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for drywall crack repair?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for drywall crack repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for drywall crack repair, prioritize experience, especially with local Bay Area homes. Look for contractors who are licensed and insured, offer clear, written estimates, and have positive reviews or references. A good contractor will also conduct a thorough assessment to determine the crack's cause before recommending a repair solution, ensuring a lasting fix rather than a temporary patch.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for licensed, insured, and experienced contractors with good reviews. They should offer clear estimates and thoroughly assess the crack's cause before repair.
